name: Boat
overview: Entrepreneur Vitaly Alperovich promised his father to give him a boat as a child. Years later, he decides to fulfill this promise: he buys an old ship to restore it and set sail. Anton Lisenko, an experienced marine mechanic who is well versed in everything related to the sea, but not in business, comes to his aid. Together, they will have to turn a dream into reality in 14 days and prove that success requires both ingenuity and perseverance.
